source.method_evidence: Static ARM64 code and decoded serialized assets; no device interaction was performed

gamepad.movement: An accepted touch starting in controlsHitbox joins the movement set; Sign(touchX-hitboxCenterX) is summed and clamped with Math.Sign
gamepad.jump: Other accepted touches on the GamepadController raycast surface join the jump set; held member sets isJumping
gamepad.coordinate_limit: These are Unity UI local coordinates. Parent canvas scaling, safe area, user control-position settings and the actual device must be observed/calibrated before issuing touches.

joystick.movement: On Began, a touch on JoystickController inside the scaled joystick acceptance radius claims joystick.touchingFingerID; movement updates for that finger
joystick.jump: Other accepted touch IDs are in a jump HashSet, and held members set isJumping

jump_edges.request: jumpBuffer is reset only on held && !previousHeld, then previousHeld=held
jump_edges.implication: Additional jumps require a release/repress edge; an uninterrupted held touch does not create repeated jump requests
jump_edges.hold_semantics: Held state is also read by PlatformerHull.FixedUpdate, so hold duration affects the jump behavior; do not replace all holds with zero-duration taps

input.attack_limit: No independent attack control exists in the inspected Gamepad/Joystick classes. Equipment and entity combat logic control firing/contact attacks; a fabricated attack coordinate must not be used.

crawler.runtime_stats: jumps, jumpPower, moveSpeed, health, contactDamage and contactRange come from the selected HullStats/equipment. The prefab has zero placeholders for many runtime stats; they are not valid live values.

observables.colors: PlayerStats supports separate configurable player/enemy core colors and inversion; default semantic IDs are 0 DefaultPlayer and 1 DefaultEnemy, but arbitrary named colors exist. A fixed blue-player/red-enemy detector needs explicit support/calibration and cannot be claimed universal.
observables.recording_observation: video-01-008.png visibly shows lower-left left/right arrow controls, upper-left health/shield bar, upper-right pause icon, LOST SCRAPYARD and Frozen ★5 title, a spider-like player hull with blue core and gold body. These are observations of that recording, not universal UI coordinates.
observables.external_state_limit: Serialized HUD fields and native static fields identify mechanics, but are not an external automation API. No memory-reading interface is asserted.

controller_constraints: Observe/calibrate actual touch targets for the selected scheme and resolution before first input
Implement jump release/repress edges and simultaneous move+jump gestures
Do not assume the number of air jumps from old farmer settings; actual loadout must be configured or observed
Detect and release inputs when the foreground package, orientation or selected screen is unexpected
Treat unseen state/color variants as unsupported instead of issuing blind movement
